title: Grateful Dead Live at The Centrum on 1987-04-04
lineage: MAC > Sony TC-D5M (no Dolby) > Marantz CDR-500 > EAC > Soundforge > CD-Wave > TLH v.1.0.0.72 (for SBE-OK, FLAC compression, and checksums) > FLAC
source: Nakamichi CM-300's with CP-4 shotgun capsules > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell MX-90 cassettes, with no Dolby

ai_review.summary: Exceptional audience recording with crystal‑clear sound and an emotional moment before Box of Rain, placing the show among the top Dead performances.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the remarkable AUD quality, calling it one of the best audience recordings they own. The highlight is the crowd’s spontaneous "we want Phil" chant right before a moving rendition of Box of Rain, which many say brings them to tears. No technical flaws are noted, making this both a superb sonic document and a memorable performance.

ai_rating.rationale: All five‑star reviews praise both the musical moment and the flawless audience recording; with consistent high praise across two detailed reviews, the combined show and recording quality merit a near‑top rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the AUD as crystal‑clear, crisp, and among the best audience recordings available; no issues or artifacts mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is highlighted by an emotional crowd chant for Phil just before Box of Rain, creating a poignant and memorable flow that many fans rank among the top performances.

band_member_comments.Phil: Crowd chanting "we want Phil" was answered, making the moment especially special for listeners.
